check_package_requirement: check if a package like transformers>=4.28.0 satisfies the installed version requirement
decorate_function_with_require: decorate a function with the require decorator to enforce a dependency before calling it
verify_multimodal_available: verify whether multimodal dependencies pycocotools and transformers are installed using WITH_MULTIMODAL
register_multimodal_placeholder_module: register a placeholder module that raises ImportError when multimodal dependencies are missing
review_require_decorator: review the require decorator to understand how it wraps functions with dependency checks
